test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A tank, 4 m long, 2 m wide and 1.5 m deep, is dug in field 22 m long and 14 m wide. If the earth dug out is evenly spread out over the remaining field, then the level of the field will rise by:
solution:
**Given:**

Dimensions of the tank: 4 m (length) × 2 m (width) × 1.5 m (depth)

Dimensions of the field: 22 m (length) × 14 m (width)

**Formula Used:**

Volume of the tank = Length × Width × Depth

Area of the remaining field = Total Area of the field - Area of the tank

Height rise = Volume of the tank / Area of the remaining field

**Calculation:**

Volume of the tank = 4 m × 2 m × 1.5 m

⇒ Volume of the tank = 12 m³

Area of the field = 22 m × 14 m

⇒ Area of the field = 308 m²

Area of the tank = 4 m × 2 m

⇒ Area of the tank = 8 m²

Area of the remaining field = 308 m² - 8 m²

⇒ Area of the remaining field = 300 m²

Height rise = Volume of the tank / Area of the remaining field

⇒ Height rise = 12 m³ / 300 m²

⇒ Height rise = 0.04 m

⇒ Height rise = 0.04 m × 100 cm/m

⇒ Height rise = 4 cm

**The level of the field will rise by 4 cm.**
